name: landscape-video-layers
note: Landscape audit (2026-10-05) Direction A, video layers. On a 340px-tall landscape phone the theater card was a 142x105 postage stamp and its scrim (z-94) sat over the mini bar (z-60), so Shuffle/Prev/Play/Next all hit-tested to the scrim - the transport was dead while the video showed. The docked PIP (152x110 at bottom+150px, right:10px) floated mid-screen over +Add / Start / Save, with a 30px park tab beside it. Asserts at 915x340 and 740x320 on a fresh device (a new song opens the theater, round 19): the video is >=180px tall, clear of the bar and the rail, every bar transport control hit-tests to itself above the scrim and is >=44px, the theater handles are >=44px and live, the scrim still covers the viewport, and Pause on the bar pauses without docking. Docked, the PIP lives INSIDE the bar's leading slot: on Songs, Setlist and the two-pane Tune nothing of the video layer covers content or the bar's title/transport, and the PIP still expands to the theater.

steps.selector: [data-npkey='reggae backing track in a major|petti music studios|A|major']
[data-npkey='reggae backing track in a major|petti music studios|A|major'] .li-body
